project.name: Primitive
release_notes: Firestore integer JSON queries now decode the same strict unsigned and exact signed-integer document projection as point reads. Native Go SDK object encoding and integer decoding execute through jsonio without a second JSON formatter.

JSONIO can lend explicit typed native codecs to owned whole-value documents, preserving owner causes, pointer-null policy and exact integer projections. Kernel Temporal numeric persistence can use this capability without importing a JSON engine.

Plunk attachment admission refuses Unicode format characters and media-type filename parameters. Hostfacts can observe paired native ancestor memory limit, charge and saturating minimum headroom; an observation is not a reservation or a guarantee of future workload capacity.
